confidence.rationale: Internal trial splitting demonstrated out-of-sample stability, but the same dataset and task supplied both partitions and external validation remains absent.

claims.statement: In mouse VTA recordings, a dopamine neuron's reversal point estimated from one random half of trials predicted its reversal point in the held-out half, as expected under a stable heterogeneous distributional code.

confidence.rationale: Formal update rules and causal dopamine-learning experiments support the account, but simple one-to-one dopamine-RPE identity claims face empirical limits.
